text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
How is it, is everyone having fuuun!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even a quiet voice is fine!
Let's all shout together! Ready, and—!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Tachyon.
I guess live performances really aren't for me—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hold back on saying those words.
It is far too early to draw a conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
(...Some people are staying,
but others are leaving the venue.)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
(Continuing the live performance like this might not help bring the Grand Live here.
In that case, I should wrap things up quickly and explain—)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Louder, everyone!
Let's shout together! Ready, and—!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: (Still... Falcon-san is still...)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ready, and!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I-I'm having fun!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: So please, sing more!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Roger that!
Let's get things even more hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Can't we stick around
and watch that concert just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ...Sure. It actually sounds kind of fun.

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're humming along.
Looks like you're getting pretty into it too.

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"W-What's wrong with that!
I just felt like singing, okay...?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, just like that!
Let's all sing together!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Because this is a concert where I want to ask everyone to sing along with me!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Now then,
the real change starts from here.

And just like that, everyone turned their eyes
back to the live stage, as if re-evaluating something.
